$comment: D-CSUBSET-GNU-UNKNOWN-NAME-GATE-ASYMMETRY, the THIRD (file-scope) tier — P44 lane a. An unmodelled GNU attribute NAME is ignorable vocabulary, not a constraint violation: gcc 13.3.0 (-std=c2x), clang 18.1.3 (-std=c23) and mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0, probed SEPARATELY, all compile this and exit 0 with `'<name>' attribute directive ignored [-Wattributes]`, while DSS exited 1 with `error[H000C] '<name>' is not a recognized linkage specifier`. THE FIX IS THE ENGINE OBEYING CONFIG IT ALREADY HAD: `DeclarationRule::unknownStrictAttributeIsError` is the language's per-row statement of this exact verdict and the SEMANTIC tier has honoured it since TF-C73, while the HIR linkage tier hardcoded Error and never read it — two tiers, one config-driven, one not, which is the asymmetry itself. Measured split: every c row that reaches `linkageFrom` (topLevelDecl / varDecl / externDecl / autoInferredVarDecl — the four carrying a `linkageSpecifiers` table) declares `false` and got an error anyway; every row declaring `true` (typedef / struct / union / enum / struct-field / union-field) carries NO linkageSpecifiers and never reaches that tier. WHY A RUNNABLE ARTIFACT AND NOT A COMPILE-ONLY PIN: 'accepted' is only half the contract — an IGNORED attribute must also leave the declaration it decorates untouched, so all three decorated entities are USED and exit 42 = 11 + 13 + 18 is reachable only if the global kept its initializer, the static function kept its body and internal linkage, and the doubly-decorated global kept its value. WARNED, NEVER SILENTLY DROPPED: each name still emits warning[H_UnknownLinkageSpecifier], so the typo protection survives as a diagnostic and `--warnings-as-errors` restores the old refusal. FOUR TARGETS: pe runs natively on the Windows gate host (an elf-only manifest is a vacuous pass there), elf x86_64 + arm64 under qemu on Linux, macho on darwin. RED-ON-DISABLE: restore the hardcoded `DiagnosticSeverity::Error` at `linkageFrom`'s unknown-name arm and this example fails to compile on every leg. The release arm runs the optimizer over the decorated declarations.
